scope_change_reason: The draw selected independent-verification. Its first arithmetic card led to already independently checked raw-price and packing-cap inputs (PR2359/2360). This takes the second suggestion, formal-interface-lemma, for the pending all-batch P112 cost boundary rather than a lemma already identified in the selected review. PR2342 explicitly excludes auditing the broader PR2338 proof.

stop_rule: Prove the named implication, its count/power consequences and semantic counterexamples, or report a precise blocker. No whole-P112-floor or new-exponent claim.
